frontPage.headline: The World Takes the Floor.
frontPage.standfirst: Fourteen editions of debate, diplomacy and dialogue — one platform for tomorrow’s leaders.
story: Sreenidhi Model United Nations returns for its fourteenth edition at Sreenidhi International School, Hyderabad, from 30 October to 1 November 2026. The conference brings students together to discuss global issues, represent countries and explore solutions through debate and diplomacy.

Through committee sessions and discussions, delegates will have the opportunity to develop their research, public speaking and negotiation skills. SMUN XIV aims to create an environment where different perspectives can be shared and ideas can lead to meaningful discussions.
frontPage.photoCaption: Fig. 1 — The Flame of Sreenidhi, ignited on arrival.

inside.committees: Every committee, its agenda and its board.

letter.closing: With immense pride and excitement, we look forward to welcoming you to SMUN XIV for three days of diplomacy, collaboration and meaningful change.
